violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFICATION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED PAPER TOWELS MISSING AT THE SINK NEAR CASH REGISTER AND THE SINK NEAR THE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD BE PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH TOWELS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN THE HALL OF THE BACK KITCHEN WITHOUT SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS POSTED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE OBTAIN A FOOD THERMOMETER BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: OBSERVED NO THERMOMETER IN THE TWO-DOOR PREP TOP OR THE DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS WITH TCS FOODS HAVE AN ACCURATE UNIT THERMOMETER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 149.3F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE ENSURE THE DISHWASHING MACHINE IS NOT USED TO SANITIZE DISHWARE UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MEET 160F AT A MINIMUM. THE THREE- COMPARTMENT SINK SHOULD BE USED TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZE DISHWARE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the LACTIC ACID sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a LACTIC ACID test kit BY THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. HYATT PLACE HERNDON DULLES (Inspection Date: 03/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PLEASE OBTAIN HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH-PLATE OR HIGH HEAT TEST STRIPS FOR THE DISHWASHING MACHINE BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 157.5F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. PIC CONTACTED ECOLAB DURING INSPECTION AND THREE-VAT SINK WAS SET-UP TO SANITIZE DISHWARE. PLEASE ENSURE DISHWASHING MACHINE IS NOT USED UNTIL IT CAN MEET 160F AT A MINIMUM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED SANITIZER DISPENSER AT THE THREE-VAT SINK NOT DISPENSING ENOUGH SANITIZER AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. MAINTENANCE TEAM WAS NOTIFIED OF ISSUE AND WILL CONTACT CONTRACTOR TO REPAIR DISPENSER IF NEEDED. SANITIZER WILL BE HAND-MIXED UNTIL THE DISPENSER IS REPAIRED.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: THE SINK DRAIN STOPPER FOR THE SANITIZER BASIN AT THE THREE-VAT SINK IS NOT WORKING; WATER SLOWLY LEAKS OUT.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. MAINTENANCE TEAM STARTED WORKING ON ISSUE DURING INSPECTION TO ENSURE SINK CAN HOLD WATER.
